panels.title: Alerts
panels.description: Firing in Alertmanager, excluding the Watchdog heartbeat.

panels.title: Mains
panels.description: ups.status OL flag from the UPS on pve-2.

panels.title: Internet
panels.description: TCP connect to 1.1.1.1 and 8.8.8.8. Offline only when both fail.

panels.title: VPS
panels.description: inside.merox.dev — the off-site backup target.

panels.title: Hosts
panels.description: Proxmox hosts answering. Each carries one control plane.

panels.title: K8s nodes
panels.description: Ready nodes. Two is still a quorum; one is not.

panels.title: ZFS pools
panels.description: Pools not ONLINE (degraded, faulted, suspended). Error counters on an online pool are sas-health-check.sh's job.

panels.title: Stuck pods
panels.description: Pending, Failed or Unknown.

panels.title: Local backup
panels.description: Oldest last-backup among the Longhorn volumes that are backed up — to Garage on pve-2, nightly at 23:50. Per-volume detail is in the Longhorn dashboard.

panels.title: Off-site
panels.description: Last completed restic push to Oracle, nightly at 03:10, append-only. This is the copy that carries the Immich library, Nextcloud files and /media/photos. Healthchecks.io alerts if it stops; this tile shows it.

panels.title: VM image
panels.description: Newest vzdump image of VM 1000 (Nextcloud), weekly on Saturday at 22:00.

panels.title: Certificates
panels.description: Until the soonest certificate expires. Let's Encrypt shortlived: ~6.7 days, renewed at ~2.2 days left, so anything above 2 days is normal.

panels.title: Download
panels.description: Last Ookla speedtest. Runs every 4 h — each run moves ~1.8 GB.

panels.title: Upload
panels.description: Last Ookla speedtest. Runs every 4 h — each run moves ~1.8 GB.

panels.title: Round trip
panels.description: TCP handshake to the nearer of 1.1.1.1 / 8.8.8.8, measured constantly.

panels.title: Throughput history
panels.description: One point per test, every 4 h, so the line steps rather than curves.

panels.title: Round trip history
panels.description: Gaps are outages: a failed probe has no round trip to plot.

panels.title: Temperature
panels.description: Hottest hwmon sensor per host — CPU cores and NVMe. The R730xd's fans follow drive temperature, not this.

panels.title: Storage fill
panels.description: Every Proxmox storage on every host. PveStorageNearFull fires at 80 %, Critical at 90 %.

panels.title: SSD wear
panels.description: Rated endurance used. pve-1's nvme1n1 is the QLC drive that took 3.5x write amplification under a ZFS zvol until 2026-09-07 — the one to watch. SAS disks are not here: they are parked, and sas-health-check.sh reads them nightly.

panels.title: Runtime left
panels.description: NUT shuts every host down at 300 s (battery.runtime.low).

panels.title: Estate draw
panels.description: Everything behind the UPS. Derived: it reports load only as a percentage of 390 W.

panels.title: R730xd
panels.description: PSU reading from iDRAC. 112 W is the tuned baseline with the SAS disks parked.

panels.title: Draw history
panels.description: The gap between the two lines is pve-1, pve-3 and the switch.

panels.title: Runtime history
panels.description: Estimated on mains. Drifting down over months is how the battery announces its age.
